claim_ceiling: Language-dominated baseline embeddings do not support legally coherent fractal mapping.
evidence_summary: Verified 11 evidence artifacts across baseline (embeddings, projection, metadata), hierarchical clustering (Leiden 8 resolutions, Agglomerative 5 resolutions, HDBSCAN 5 resolutions), multi-scale UMAP (6 n_neighbors), hierarchical zoom UMAP (7 levels), local UMAP (9 samples), and evaluation (purity, NMI, size distributions). All quantitative claims in cycle_report.md independently recomputed and confirmed: language purity 93-100% vs legal-area purity 17-58% across all methods; Leiden hierarchy NMI 0.79-0.91 but splits follow language boundaries; Agglomerative severely imbalanced (96% in one cluster at n=10); HDBSCAN high noise (28-40%). No leakage, benchmark gaming, prettiness-as-quality, weak baseline confounding, or unsupported product claims detected. Negative result honestly represented at EXPLORATORY tier. PIVOT_WITHIN_MISSION to legal-distance lane correctly justified.
